step1.heading: Upload Picture
step1.description: Upload a clear photo of a wheat or cotton leaf (good lighting, close-up of the affected area). High-quality images yield more accurate results. Avoid blurry shots and try capturing different angles.

step2.heading: AI-Powered Disease Detection
step2.description: Our AI analyzes the uploaded image, compares it with trained samples, and instantly identifies the disease. It highlights patterns like discoloration, fungal spots, and texture variations with high accuracy.

step3.heading: Personalized Recommendations
step3.description: Receive actionable treatment and prevention tips including chemical, organic, and cultural practices to protect your crops and boost long-term harvest health.

hero.subtitle: Combining Artificial Intelligence with Agriculture to protect crops, increase yield, and ensure food security.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.description: Our mission is to empower farmers through AI technology — enabling them to detect crop diseases in wheat and cotton with just one image. We aim to minimize crop loss, improve productivity, and support sustainable farming practices.

whatWeDo.title: What We Do
whatWeDo.description: Our AI system analyzes uploaded crop leaf images to detect diseases like *Wheat Leaf Rust* or *Cotton Curl Virus* in seconds. It then recommends scientifically proven treatments and preventive steps. The goal: help farmers make quick, informed decisions with just one click.

items.title: Late Disease Detection
items.description: Farmers often realize disease symptoms when it's too late, causing irreversible damage.

items.title: Lack of Expert Guidance
items.description: Most rural farmers lack direct access to agronomists or agricultural experts.

items.title: High Pesticide Cost
items.description: Overuse of chemicals increases expenses and harms soil quality long-term.

items.title: Low Yield Efficiency
items.description: Diseases and pest attacks can drastically reduce harvest productivity.

items.title: Climate-Driven Challenges
items.description: Rising temperatures and humidity create ideal conditions for crop diseases.

items.title: Unawareness of AI Tools
items.description: Many farmers remain unaware of how digital tools can help them monitor crop health.

vision.title: Our Vision for the Future
vision.description: We envision a world where every farmer — whether in remote villages or modern cities — can access AI tools to protect their crops and maximize yield. Our goal is to make agriculture smarter, greener, and more sustainable for generations to come.

wheatRust.description: Wheat Leaf Rust is a fungal disease caused by Puccinia triticina.
wheatRust.suggestion: Apply Mancozeb fungicide and ensure proper irrigation.

cottonVirus.description: A viral disease transmitted by whiteflies causing leaf curling.
cottonVirus.suggestion: Use resistant varieties and control whitefly population.
